title: Teriyaki Salmon
author: Claude
description: Pan-fried salmon glazed in a quick soy, honey and ginger sauce, with rice and broccoli.
steps: Start the rice. Stir together the soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic and 2 tbsp water.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Fry the salmon skin-side down in a little sesame oil for 4 minutes, turn, and cook for 2 more.
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble until glossy, spooning it over the salmon. Serve with the rice and broccoli, topped with scallions.
